purpose: Converts Markdown text to complete HTML documents for live preview and standalone export using cmark-gfm.
calls_out_to: cmark_parser_new / cmark_parser_feed / cmark_parser_finish / cmark_render_html — cmark-gfm parse+render pipeline
EscapeHtml — title and base URI escaping
ReadUtf8FileAsWide — loads preview.css for standalone export
invariants: BuildPreview embeds assets via https://markdownplusplus.local virtual origin (served by WebView2 custom scheme)
BuildStandaloneDocument inlines CSS and uses file:// URIs for assets to be self-contained
GFM extensions loaded: table, strikethrough, autolink, tagfilter, tasklist
gotchas: kDocumentBaseUri (https://markdownplusplus.document/) is the virtual origin used as base href when a document directory exists; WebViewHost maps this to the real filesystem path via SetVirtualHostNameToFolderMapping
CMARK_OPT_GITHUB_PRE_LANG adds the language class to pre blocks, required for syntax highlighting in preview.js
